source: Planned by the app's own planRoute (src/services/routing.ts) against the live database, through the same path as a Go in the app. Generated once, then committed; never hand-edited, and re-run rather than patched when the figures need to change. Grades and distances are as planned; minutes are the app's live-traffic figure (liveSeconds) at the moment of the run, so they are shown for the daytime plan only. No place names on purpose: the site names regions, and never lets a reader connect a suburb to risk. The trips come from the fixed list in the app's scripts/qa/probeTrips.ts, chosen to show a spread, so they are not an average.
